Textual Amendments
F172 Sch. 4 para. 16 omitted (4.4.2005) and repealed (prosp.) by virtue of Criminal Justice Act 2003 (c. 44),
ss. 311(10), 332, 336, Sch. 37 Pt. 12; S.I. 2005/950, art. 2 (with art. 2(2) and Sch. 2)

17 In section 42(3) omit “in England and Wales”, and after “Attorney General” insert
“ for Northern Ireland ”.
Part V of this Act

18 In section 45 for subsections (1) to (8) substitute—
“(1) Article 4 of the Criminal Justice (Serious Fraud)(Northern Ireland) Order

1988 (notices of transfer in cases of serious or complex fraud) shall be
amended as mentioned in subsections (2) and (3).

(2) In paragraph (7)(a) (regulations) for the words “a statement of the evidence”
there shall be substituted “copies of the documents containing the evidence
(including oral evidence)”.
